selection_rule: Call the exact frozen decide() on concatenated original candidate-context records in each union group. Same model/scaler/threshold0.5/exact-score-tie abstention. cohort_projection: After freeze map previous correspondence BP IDs to operational components. All relevant IDs in one component: report that frozen component decision. catastrophic_rule: Absolute selected timing error >100ms (same prior association tolerance), scoring only. Also report all >20/>30ms errors and correct yields, not just selected timing.
